notes: Inbound from fintech startup focused on merchant payments reconciliation and dispute resolution.
Primary ask: hosted API for fast time-to-value. Self-serve signup + early usage of free credits; moved to discovery after active questions.
Security early asks: SOC2 (Type II) artifacts, SSO/SAML for team access, audit logs and KMS support.
Deployment posture: wants to start on public hosted offering, 'VPC-curious' — timeline: evaluate in 6-12 months depending on compliance and volume.
Workloads: embeddings for transaction search (approx 50k historical txns initial), chat assistant for customer ops (internal + external-facing), reranker for fraud signals.
Latency/throughput targets: embeddings retrieval <150ms median; chat interactions P95 <500ms for short prompts; ~20-50 qps expected in Q2.
Cost sensitivity: early-stage, tight unit-economics. CFO asked for per-embedding and per-chat cost scenarios at projected 50k queries/month.
Model preferences: open to tuned Llama/GPT-style open models if Redwood provides perf/cost wins; wants Redwood-verified benchmarks.
Quote from CTO (Maya R.): 'We need a plug-and-play hosted API to get features in product this quarter. If security gates pass, we'll consider Dedicated later.',
POC plan: 2-week embeddings POC — Redwood to run sample index (50k rows) + demo similarity search; AE to allocate $2k credit for POC testing.
Potential upsell: Dedicated or Private in 6–12 months if throughput and compliance needs increase. Optimize add-on interesting for batch/cost tuning.
Current blockers: internal security wants SOC2 doc + SSO flow diagram; finance wants 12-month ARR scenario; legal asking about transaction data residency (EU customers).
